record.question: International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women is observed on
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: The observance is held on 25 November. The date commemorates the Mirabal sisters, who were killed on 25 November 1960, and the UN established the international day in 1999. Keep it separate from International Women’s Day on 8 March and Human Rights Day on 10 December. These days are related to rights and equality but have different names and dates; 25 November is the one specifically addressing the elimination of violence against women.
